Proof

↗ cor:kl-solution-curvature-normalized-volume-control-each-other-existence-kappa-solutions ↗ cor:kl-two-dimensional-solutions-kappa-solutions-corollary ↗ prop:kl-asymptotic-scalar-curvature-asymptotic-volume-ratio-existence-kappa-solutions \sketch Normalize $R(x_k,0)=1$ and apply Corollary 6.4. An unbounded-curvature limit would contain necks with cross-sections tending to zero, impossible by the Sharafutdinov exhaustion in the one-ended case and by line splitting in the two-ended case. The exhaustion is by totally convex sets satisfying

\begin{equation} C_{t_1}=\{ q\in C_{t_2}:\dist (q,\partial C_{t_2})\geq t_2-t_1\} . \end{equation}

□
